stories.title: 6 days left to save up to $200 to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference called TechCrunch Disrupt is offering a $200 discount on tickets if you buy within the next 6 days.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people in the tech industry — nothing you need to act on if you run a regular small business.

stories.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
stories.simple_summary: Companies building AI systems that can model the world are not telling anyone what they're actually working on, keeping their plans secret.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't affect most small business owners right now — it's mainly about what large tech companies are doing behind closed doors.

stories.title: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?
stories.simple_summary: Tech executives are saying they want to slow down AI development, but there's debate about whether they're being serious.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't change anything you need to do today — it's about what the tech industry *might* do in the future.

stories.title: No one is surprised that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown.
stories.simple_summary: The head of Nvidia, a company making chips for AI, says fears about AI being dangerous are overblown.
stories.why_it_matters: This is just one person's opinion — he makes money from AI, so he's naturally going to be optimistic about it. This doesn't affect your immediate decisions.

stories.title: Vocci’s ring adds a new form factor to meeting note-taking
stories.simple_summary: A company made a smart ring that costs $249 and records notes from meetings.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a new gadget for people who take lots of meeting notes — useful for some business owners, but not essential, and it could raise privacy concerns.

stories.title: ScrollEd wants to turn textbooks into TikTok
stories.simple_summary: A new app turns textbooks into short videos and interactive lessons, like scrolling through TikTok.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in school, this could make learning more fun, but it's still just one new educational tool among many.

stories.title: Trump now says he wants to form an ‘AI Force’
stories.simple_summary: The president announced plans to create an 'AI Force' with an 'AI czar' to oversee artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This could mean new government rules around AI eventually, but it's too early to know what that will actually look like or how it might affect you.

stories.title: Humans, not rogue AI, are still the biggest cybersecurity risk to energy systems
stories.simple_summary: The biggest security threat to power systems is still people, not AI — hackers breaking into systems through human mistakes.
stories.why_it_matters: Good news for homeowners and small businesses: the scary AI hacking stories overshadow the real problem, which is actually older security weaknesses.

stories.title: Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook) made an AI assistant called Muse that can read your messages, calendar, and notes — and people find it unsettling.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta products, be aware that this AI tool can access your personal information, so think carefully before using it if that worries you.

stories.title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
stories.simple_summary: The company Flock is offering money to employees who voluntarily quit to avoid having to lay people off.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a business restructuring story — only relevant if you work there or own a similar tech company.

stories.title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
stories.simple_summary: The president suggested giving AI a new name and announced creating an 'AI Force' government group, calling AI fears a hoax.
stories.why_it_matters: This is political talk about AI — the actual impact on your life is unclear and probably still years away.

stories.title: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
stories.simple_summary: Google's AI system successfully broke into other computer systems as a test, then stopped itself.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a controlled test by Google researchers — not a real cyberattack — but it shows AI systems can be used to find security weaknesses.
